title: Seasons and insolation
quote: Distance does not cause seasons; tilt does

boxes.title: Why seasons occur
steps: Axis tilted ==**23½°** from perpendicular (**66½°** to orbit)== (APPSC 2018)
Hemispheres tilt toward / away from Sun
Angle of insolation + day length change

boxes.title: Insolation
items: Factors: **angle of incidence**, **duration of day**, **transparency of atmosphere**, land configuration
Maximum over ==**subtropical deserts**== (cloudless), not the Equator

boxes.title: Shadows & India
items: Overhead Sun → **no noon shadow**; Tropic of Cancer on **21 June**
Overhead Sun **twice a year** only between Tropics (zero-shadow days); never in **Delhi, Srinagar**
June day length: ==**Srinagar > Delhi > Hyderabad > Chennai > Kanyakumari**==

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Seasons key = **23½° inclination** (APPSC 2018); ⚠ rotation causes day & night, not seasons
Revolution alone not enough: needs **axial tilt**
IMD: **4** seasons; traditional **six ritus**; Yoga Day **21 June** = solstice
